pages.title: Fluids
pages.text: Active reactors work by boiling a fluid, and every pair of liquid and gas is a $(thing)transition$(): a boiling point, a latent heat, a thermal conductivity for each phase and a turbine multiplier.

pages.title: Steam
pages.text: What water becomes. The default working fluid for a reactor and turbine pair.$(br2)Water in through a Coolant Port, steam out, steam into the turbine, water back to the reactor.

pages.title: Liquid Obsidian
pages.text: Boils into lava at a much higher temperature than water boils into steam.$(br2)A reactor hot enough to use it moves far more heat per tick than one running on water, at the cost of needing to stay very hot.

pages.title: Superheated Sodium
pages.text: The gas phase of liquid sodium. Sodium is an excellent moderator inside a reactor and a high temperature coolant outside one.$(br2)The mod ships the transition and the moderator values, but the sodium itself comes from another mod. With $(thing)Mekanism$() installed its sodium boils into superheated sodium here.

pages.title: Liquid Uranium
pages.text: Molten uranium, present for pack integration and for anything that wants a fluid form of the mod's fuel.$(br2)It has no bucket of its own, so you will only meet it through pipes and tanks.
